preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index x ON x.indexrelid = c.oid WHERE n.nspname = current_schema() AND c.relname = 'idx_proc_events_log_segment' AND x.indisvalid

SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class c JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = current_schema() AND c.relname = 'process_events' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_inherits i WHERE i.inhparent = c.oid )

changeSet.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS IDX_PROC_EVENTS_LOG_SEGMENT

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IDX_PROC_EVENTS_LOG_SEGMENT ON PROCESS_EVENTS ( INSTANCE_ID, INSTANCE_CREATED_AT, ((EVENT_DATA::jsonb ->> 'logSegmentId')::varchar), EVENT_SEQ ) WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'ELEMENT' AND ((EVENT_DATA::jsonb ->> 'logSegmentId')::varchar) IS NOT NULL
